received_works.body:
Nice to meet you.
I am writing to you because of a wonderful illustration I happened to see by chance.
I would like to request a standing picture for an event for my child, who is active in TRPGs and games using original characters, and would appreciate your consideration.

She looks like the one in the link below.

https://moo-tyaunen.ssl-lolipop.jp/txiloda/picture.php?user=yutayuta&file=mana_smile.png

https://moo-tyaunen.ssl-lolipop.jp/txiloda/picture.php?user=yutayuta&file=ran_state.png

Usage.
SNS, free distribution of personally produced games, TRPGs, and games using original characters.
We plan to use them as player characters.

Rules
When using illustrations, be sure to post your name and
We will not use the work for the purpose of making money for ourselves, nor will we use the work for our own profit.

Requests
The original character linked above.
Swimsuit costume (standing picture), please.
The image is a miko style swimsuit like the one shown in the link below.
We will leave the pose and details of the design to you.

https://gomaotsu.jp/archives/characters/2564

We are sorry for your busy schedule, but thank you in advance for your cooperation.

Nice to meet you. My name is Yukitsune Mifuyu, and I'm a personal Vtuber.
I saw a very cute illustration by Ms. Kikiyu on Twitter!
https://twitter.com/kikiyu698/status/1461678303111049220

I'd love for you to draw my character Mifuyu in the same pose putting up her hair in a cute cat pajama outfit.
I'll put the outfit I want in the pictures. And I'd love for her to be in a bedroom.

The file format should be PSD.
We would appreciate it if you could separate the layers for the background and the person, as we may use only the character.

Usage
Use on Twitch or Twitter

Other
It would be great if you could add "#Mifuart" when you post on Twitter!

Thank you again for your consideration. ❤️ 

Details of Vtuber below

She's a Snowfox shrine maiden who loves comfy days and drinking tea
She has 2 tails that she can make appear and disappear at will.
She has quite a big chest but is very modest about it.
She has pet foxes that play with her occasionally
She's very cheerful and sweet but can be quite absent-minded at times. 

https://imgur.com/a/E761Vxb

Hello! I'm a big fan of your artwork! Your style is very cute and beautiful!
You are one of my favorite artists! It would be such an honor to be drawn by you.
It would be nice if I could request you to draw my OC!

Her name is Karinn. She is a cute, cheerful cat girl who loves drawing, kitten, small flowers, and eating Sundae ice cream! She is petite in size (about 150 cm) and has a beauty mark (dark spot) under her right eye.

This is her full-body reference. (Please ignore the original hair color. I drew her by myself but the color doesn't really represent what I really want. I'm not good at picking the color. I am so sorry〒▽〒):
https://refsheet.net/media/c04a564973b19852

I would love you to color her hair desaturated yellowish light blonde hair color same as this one:
https://skeb.jp/@kikiyu698/works/8

And her eyes color would be purple, the same as this one:
https://twitter.com/kikiyu698/status/1467777868868747265/photo/1

For more info and image please use this link:
https://refsheet.net/Karinn/karinn

Any cute pose is fine! Thank you for your consideration.❤

Nice to meet you.
My name is Kugirin, and I'm a personal Vtuber.

I would like to request you to draw me.
I would like to use it as a thumbnail on YouTube.
The standing picture is available at https://twitter.com/kutsugi_rin/status/1478197304188612608?s=20.

I would like to request a full body drawing with no cuts.
I would like the image to have mahjong elements.
For example, I would like her to be holding mahjong tiles or a standing stick.
For example, he is holding a mahjong tile or a standing stick, or there are mahjong-related tools around him as in the illustration at https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/86003017.

The background is up to you.
The background is up to you, but I would like to have a transparent background so that I can use it as a thumbnail.
If possible, I would be happy to receive a difference without the mahjong element (for example, a ver with mahjong tiles and a ver without mahjong tiles).

The size is also up to you.

This may be a rough request, but I would be happy if you could draw a key visual image of Butajin with a mahjong feel.

Thank you very much.

Nice to meet you! This is a request for an illustration of an original character.

Character
Silver hair two-sided up (ribbon fastened), deep red eyes like rubies, red under-rim glasses.
Her breasts are modest, she is 13 years old, she has a relatively cheerful personality, she is dressed in a cute white outfit that exposes her abdomen.
Her expression is a small open-mouthed smile.

I'd also like to have a diff without glasses or a psd with different layers.
Thank you very much for your consideration.

A young lady from a country where it snows in the polar night all the time. She has lived in Japan with her family since she was a child.
She is basically nocturnal and hates mornings and hot weather. She loves to sleep.

I'd like you to draw an illustration of Vtuber Mio Nekozuki (@Nekozuki_Mio)!

きき湯 様 
初めまして。個人Vライバーの、猫町こあめと申します。この度きき湯様の繊細でかわいいイラストを拝見し、ぜひ描いていただければとご連絡させていただきました。 

◎依頼詳細◎
・私自身(猫町こあめ)の姿をお願いしたいです。
構図の希望は、ベッドに仰向けで目を瞑り寝ていて、周りに、ピカチュウ、イーブイ、ジラーチ、アチャモなどかわいい系のポケモンも描いていただきたいです。難しければ構図変更、ポケモンモチーフのぬいぐるみや普通の動物に置き換えたりしても構いません。
服装は変えていただいても構いません。
かわいい、ふわふわしたイメージだと嬉しいです。
また、難しい場合は大丈夫ですが、目を開けたパターン、ニコッと笑ってるパターンの差分も描いていただけると嬉しいです…！

＊キャラクター詳細＊
・代々雨男雨女家系で、苦労しないように「こあめ」と名付けられたが、どう足掻いても雨女
・爬虫類とサメと恐竜がすき
・本当の海にいるコサメ達と仲良くなりたいが、怖がりなのでぬいぐるみで慣れようと日々努力している
・歌うことが好き

サメのぬいぐるみたちはどのように描いても大丈夫です、お任せします。(ピンク色のサメは青色のサメと違って、猫耳のようなヒレになってます)
参照:https://twitter.com/nekomachi_koame/status/1410552917673775115?s=19

・サイズは16:9横長(1920×1080だと嬉しいです)で、体全体が入るイラスト希望ですが、バランス等問題あればそれ以外のショットでも構いません。

 ・私のPCの壁紙や配信やSNSで使用させていただきたいと思っております。 可能でしたら背景、サインなどは別レイヤーにして頂ければ幸いです。

 
スケブを使用した依頼の経験が浅く、不明点や失礼がありましたら申し訳ございません。 
 お忙しい中恐縮ではございますが、ご検討よろしくお願いします。
